conferences.name: Experimental Psychology Society (EPS) meetings
conferences.edition: EPS Meeting, University College London, January 2027

deadlines.label: Abstract submission portal (opened 10am UK time and closed after 24 hours, so submissions are now closed)

conferences.typical_timing: The EPS has no fixed deadline. Its portal opens briefly for each meeting: early September for the January meeting, early January for the Spring meeting and early April for the Summer meeting. The next meeting after London is Cardiff University, 7th–9th April 2027, and its portal should open in early January 2027.

conferences.name: TeaP (Tagung experimentell arbeitender Psycholog:innen)
conferences.typical_timing: Abstract submission usually runs from late October to mid-November. TeaP 2026 talks and posters were due 27 Oct–16 Nov 2025, and symposia 1–19 Oct 2025. ESCOP lists the TeaP 2027 deadline only as 'around October/November 2026'.

conferences.name: European Conference on Visual Perception (ECVP)
conferences.edition: ECVP 2027 (49th European Conference on Visual Perception)
conferences.typical_timing: usually April. For ECVP 2026, the abstract and early-bird registration deadline was extended to April 21, and symposium proposals closed in late January.

conferences.name: AMLaP (Architectures and Mechanisms for Language Processing)
conferences.typical_timing: Abstract deadline usually falls in early May, about four months before a early-September conference. AMLaP 2026 (2–4 Sept 2026, Saarbrücken, now past) had an abstract deadline in early May 2026. LINGUIST List gave 1 May and Lingalert gave 8 May. The AMLaP 2027 host, dates and deadlines were not found.

conferences.name: MathPsych / ICCM
conferences.edition: MathPsych/ICCM 2027 (60th Annual Meeting of the Society for Mathematical Psychology / 25th International Conference on Cognitive Modeling)
conferences.typical_timing: Usually late February. The 2024 call closed 28 February 2024, and the 2026 call closed 28 February 2026 (submissions opened in early January). Decisions were due around 30 April, and the meeting was held in July.

conferences.name: FENS Forum
conferences.typical_timing: Usually late January to early February. For FENS Forum 2026, the abstract, early registration and travel grant deadline was 27 January 2026, then extended to 5 February 2026. A late-breaking abstract call followed in mid-to-late April (closing 27 April 2026).
